resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says Ocean County. The NJ Forest Service Section B10 post and the Woodland Township article place Woodmansie in Woodland Township, Burlington County. The record has no county field, so no correction is proposed; the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Unresolved lead: an nj.com article on the 2015 fire (403 when fetched, search snippet only) reportedly says a fire tower at Woodmansie spotted that fire. If a standing tower there is confirmed, the status and today-section need rewriting. The NJ DEP fire-tower page returned empty text, so the state's list of active towers was not checked. A NJ Forest Service Facebook post (search snippet only, not fetchable) describes a 1908 tripod tower manned at Woodmansie; not used. Record's elevation 0.0 matches the register's '0 ft' but looks like a placeholder; not changed. Fact-check 2026-10-10: status changed from 'gone' to 'unknown' because of the unresolved fire-tower lead above; the story makes no claim either way.
